articles.summary: The TV industry event called the creator, writer and star of 'Catastrophe,' 'Bad Sisters' and 'Youth,' an "iconic voice" of TV and "undoubtedly one of the wittiest and funniest of our time."
articles.content: Irish actress, writer and producer Sharon Horgan will be the guest of honor at the 2027 CanneSeries Industry, the international TV event held alongside the CanneSeries television festival, organizers announced Tuesday. CanneSeries called Horgan, a BAFTA winner and Emmy nominee for her work on such series as Catastrophe , Divorce and Bad Sisters , an “iconic voice” of international TV and “undoubtedly one of the wittiest and funniest of our time.” In a statement, Albin Lewi and Claire-Marine Pietriga, artistic director and deputy artistic director of CanneSeries praised Horgan for her “sharp writing, dark humor and unflinching portrayal of human relationships,” noting her ability to “seamlessly blend comedy and drama, bringing to life complex, flawed and deeply authentic female characters.” Related Stories Movies 'You Can See Everything' Cinematographer on Billy Evans' Nude Scene and Tension Between Him and the Team General News From Westeros and Venice Festival Winner 'Woman Unknown' to 'Star City': Meet Baltic Craft Specialists Who've Worked on Int'l Productions As the co-founder of the production company Merman, they added “she continues to push the boundaries of television storytelling, championing bold narratives driven by strong female perspectives.” Horgan will attend CanneSeries Industry and will take part in its “meet with the participants” program to reflect on the key milestones of her career. The third edition of CanneSeries Industry will be held from Feb. 15-17 alongside the 10th CanneSeries festival, which runs Feb. 12-17. CanneSeries was initially a Spring event, held alongside the now-defunct TV trade fair MIPTV. It is shifting to February next year, putting it ahead of rival French TV event Series Mania, which runs March 19-26.

articles.title: ‘3 Body Problem’ Season 2 Trailer Released: “They’re Coming to Exterminate Us”
articles.summary: The first footage from the return of Netflix's sci-fi hit has arrived.
articles.content: The 3 Body Problem season two trailer is here and it features time jumps, alien threats, outer-space action and zero-gravity sex. Below is the first look at the return of Netflix ‘s adaptation of Liu Cixin’s acclaimed novels. The tagline for the new season is “They Are Here.” The show from showrunners David Benioff, D.B. Weiss and Alexander Woo also has an official description: “The alien invasion nears and humanity prepares to meet them — on Earth and beyond. While a space fleet embarks on a mission that spans centuries, a secret locked inside of one man’s mind might be humanity’s only hope for survival.” As one character warns in the trailer, “They are coming to exterminate us.” Related Stories Movies David Fincher's 'The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth': First Reactions TV Netflix's '3 Body Problem' Gets Season 2 Premiere Date, Trailer Coming Tomorrow The second season is reportedly shorter than the first, with Netflix confirming it will have six episodes instead of eight. Two years ago, Netflix renewed the series for second and third final seasons which will complete the adaptation. The season has two directors familiar to Game of Thrones fans: Jeremy Podeswa helms the first half of the season and Miguel Sapochnik directs the second half. The first season spent seven weeks in the streamer’s global Top 10 list, reaching the Top 10 in 93 countries and hitting No. 1 in 44 countries, with 46.6 million views. The cast of 3 Body Problem season two includes returning stars Jess Hong, Benedict Wong, Jovan Adepo, Eiza González, Liam Cunningham, Marlo Kelly, Sea Shimooka, Saamer Usmani, Alex Sharp and Josh Brener. New cast members include Claudia Doumit, Ellie de Lange, Alfie Allen, David Yip and Jordan Sunshine.

articles.title: Elon Musk Thinks Jeremy Culhane Needs to “Try Harder” With His ‘SNL’ Impression
articles.summary: The actor has portrayed the tech billionaire in the last two episodes of NBC's sketch comedy show.
articles.content: Elon Musk isn’t laughing at Jeremy Culhane’s impression of him on Saturday Night Live . During the cold open for the most recent episode of the NBC sketch comedy program, a CIA officer, played by host John Mulaney, gathers the nation’s most prominent tech billionaires to test their national security training. The sketch references the resignation of former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang , who stepped down following revelations of an affair with an alleged Chinese spy. Among the tech billionaires spoofed in the skit were Musk (Culhane), Mark Zuckerberg (Andrew Dismukes, Sam Altman (Ben Marshall), Peter Thiel (James Austin Johnson), Dario Amodei (Jane Wickline) and Huang (Bowen Yang) . However, Musk disagreed. The Tesla CEO replied to the tweet with his own score, writing, “I’d give them maybe 5/10 for me. They need to try harder.” In another X post , Musk replied to SNL ‘s post of the sketch with a Venn diagram with “HUMOR” written in one circle and “ SNL ” written in the other. “The good sketches” was written in the small overlap. articles.title: Fourth ‘Terminal List’ Show in the Works at Prime Video
articles.summary: This one is based on Jack Carr's Vietnam-set novel 'Cry Havoc.'
articles.content: On the heels of the Amazon-owned streamer ordering a series based on Jack Carr’s novel Savage Son , Prime Video on Monday announced it’s developing a fourth show in the franchise. Cry Havoc is based on Carr’s 2025 novel of the same name, which is set in Vietnam circa 1968 and centers on Tom Reece, the father of The Terminal List’ s James Reece, played by Chris Pratt. The show’s logline reads, “Tom Reece is a brash Navy SEAL assigned to the top secret MACV-SOG [Military Assistance Command, Vietnam-Studies and Observations Group] unit, which runs harrowing cross-border operations in Laos. When Tom’s recon team comes across plans for the upcoming Tet Offensive, it unleashes a chain of events that pulls the young warrior out of the jungles and into the shadows of Cold War espionage.” Related Stories TV Streaming Ratings: 'From' Dominates an Otherwise Quiet Halloween Week TV Prime Video Unveils 'Maxton Hall' Final Season Trailer Max Adams, a writer on The Terminal List , and showrunner David Digilio, are writing the pilot script. They developed Cry Havoc for television along with Carr and Jared Shaw, an executive producer (and actor) on the main series. Digilio will also serve as showrunner on Cry Havoc . He executive produces with Adams, Pratt (via his Indivisible Productions), Carr, Shaw, and Antoine Fuqua and Kat Samick of Fuqua Films. The studios are MRC and Amazon MGM. The flurry of activity around the Terminal List franchise comes a few weeks after the show’s second season premiere, which has scored solid viewing numbers for Prime Video. A decision on season three hasn’t come yet. Savage Son will also center on Pratt’s James Reece; the source novel also features some characters from The Terminal List , though Pratt is the only actor attached at the moment. The franchise also includes a prequel series, Dark Wolf , that premiered in August 2025.

articles.title: Louis Carr Exits as BET President
articles.content: Louis Carr has exited BET less than one year after he was named president. Carr was with the brand for 40 years. “I’m deeply grateful to Louis. For four decades, he has been one of BET’s greatest champions, helping shape the brand, its business and its connection to Black audiences and culture,” George Cheeks, co-chair and chief content officer for Skydance TV, wrote in a memo shared with staffers (and obtained by The Hollywood Reporter on Monday.) “Louis built lasting partnerships with some of the world’s leading brands and helped cement BET as a cultural force. As President, he led BET with clarity and purpose, creating renewed momentum for the brand. His passion, vision and heart have been front and center in everything he does, and it has been a privilege to partner with him.” Related Stories Movies James Gunn Says "No One From Skydance Has Seen" 'Man of Tomorrow,' Addresses "Untrue Rumors" Over 'Superman' Sequel Business HBO Max-Paramount+ Bundle Targeted by Subscribers in Lawsuit Challenging Megamerger Cheeks says Skydance “believe(s) deeply” in BET and “are committed” to its future. Carr’s tenure will officially end when 2026 officially ends. It was Carr’s decision to exit, Cheeks says. Skydance acquired BET with its Paramount merger, which closed last summer. Carr was named BET president in December 2025. “We will have more to share soon on BET leadership and structure,” Cheeks wrote on Monday. Carr’s farewell email, like his tenure, was lengthy. It’s fine.” “It’s fine. It’s fine? I mean, maybe for Trump, it’s fine,” he hit back. “He doesn’t fly commercial. He doesn’t know how to use email. His bank is a guy from Qatar. articles.title: Jimmy Kimmel Has to Clarify Morbid Emergency Alert Joke After Audience Goes Silent
articles.summary: "That was a joke," the late night host assures the crowd The post Jimmy Kimmel Has to Clarify Morbid Emergency Alert Joke After Audience Goes Silent appeared first on TheWrap .
articles.content: Jimmy Kimmel’s studio audience took his joke that FEMA and the FCC’s emergency alert system test killed 30 people literally, prompting him to assure the crowd that it was just “a joke.” “This afternoon, FEMA and the FCC conducted a test of the emergency alert system. 30 people were killed,” Kimmel said during his Tuesday night monologue for “ Jimmy Kimmel Live! ” As his studio audience fell silent, he then informed the crowd, “That was a joke.” After the studio audience burst out into laughter, likely feeling relieved from the assurance, Kimmel remarked, “Wow, we really are in trouble.” The comedian then steered his monologue back on track, noting, “I didn’t even know we still had the emergency alert system. Shouldn’t that thing have been going off 24/7 every minute of the last two years?” “You know, Guillermo [Rodriguez], in my day, we called it the emergency broadcast system,” Kimmel noted to his sidekick. “You remember that? Like, once a week, you’d have to sit through a full minute of alien spaceship fax machine noises and then right back to an episode of ‘Falcon Crest’ like nothing happened.” As Kimmel went on, he explained that the new alert had its first test today, sharing that it had “been updated to make sure it gets everyone’s attention.” At this moment, the “Jimmy Kimmel Live!” editors played footage of a shrieking sheep. “Those are the animals we’re supposed to count to go to sleep,” he further joked. “But again, that was just a test. If it was a real emergency, you would have heard the sound of Donald Trump blaming Joe Biden for it.”

articles.title: Ron Howard Warns Jim Carrey-Led ‘Grinch’ Sequel Won’t ‘Go Forward’ If the Script Isn’t ‘Great’
articles.summary: “I just have to caution everybody,” the director says The post Ron Howard Warns Jim Carrey-Led ‘Grinch’ Sequel Won’t ‘Go Forward’ If the Script Isn’t ‘Great’ appeared first on TheWrap .
articles.content: Ron Howard warned he isn’t quite ready to give the Grinch another shot at Christmas, sharing a Jim Carrey-led sequel won’t “go forward” without a “great” script. While speaking with People , the director gave an update on the highly anticipated sequel to “How the Grinch Stole Christmas, ” making it clear that the project would not move forward unless the script was in a solid place. “I just have to caution everybody that Jim [Carrey] and I aren’t going to go forward unless we think we have a great script,” Howard, who directed the 2000 holiday classic for Universal Pictures, said. “And we don’t even have a script right now.” He added: “We have really good writers and an idea that I’m excited about that I think is very much in keeping with the spirit of Dr. Seuss, his blend of comedy and fantasy. So I’m very pleased with what we have to work with, but I don’t wanna make any promises that it’s happening because Jim and I are aligned on one thing — we’re not gonna go forward unless we believe it has a chance to be great.” Howard expanded on his hesitation, noting in the interview that he and Carrey are “so proud of the original movie.” “We feel so fortunate, because it takes a little bit of luck for a movie to come together and become an evergreen the way that film has,” he shared. “And the following, the fact that it’s become a tradition in a lot of households is something that means a great deal to all of us involved, Jim and I in particular.” Howard’s update comes five months after it was reported that a “Grinch” sequel was in the works, with Alec Berg, Jeff Schaffer and David Mandel writing the script. In addition to Carrey, “How the Grinch Stole Christmas” starred Jeffrey Tambor, Christine Baranski, Bill Irwin, Molly Shannon and introduced Taylor Momsen as Cindy Lou Who. Despite being panned by critics, “The Grinch” went on to gross $346 million at the global box office more than a quarter-century ago, ranking sixth among the highest grossing films in 2000.

articles.title: Nick DiGiovanni Launches New POV Series ‘Chef’ on YouTube | Exclusive
articles.summary: The series takes viewers into the perspective of some of the top chefs at Michelin-star kitchens worldwide The post Nick DiGiovanni Launches New POV Series ‘Chef’ on YouTube | Exclusive appeared first on TheWrap .
articles.content: The series takes viewers into the perspective of some of the top chefs at Michelin-star kitchens worldwide Nick DiGiovanni brings viewers behind-the-scenes into some of the world’s most acclaimed kitchens with his new YouTube series, “Chef,” which offers a first-person look at the people and craft behind some of the best food in the world. The series will air full-length episodes on YouTube rolling out throughout 2026-27, TheWrap has exclusively learned. The premiere episode “Inside the World’s #1 Pizza Restaurant” showcased pizza maestro Anthony Mangieri of the New York-based Una Pizza Napoletana, taking viewers through an unfiltered, unedited glimpse into how he makes his award-winning pizza pies. In addition to long form episodes, DiGiovanni will air a short-form POV companion episodes. The first one shows viewers how to make Butter Chicken Shawarma. “We’re starting at world’s #1 ranked pizzeria, through the lens of a pizza chef who has spent over 40 years perfecting his craft,” DiGiovanni told TheWrap. “From there we go everywhere: a busy street cart in Japan, a Michelin-starred kitchen in London, even your favorite fast food restaurant. The viewer will be able to experience everything as if you’re standing right there in the kitchen.” The short-form videos will feature individual recipes that viewers can recreate at home, filmed start to finish from the chef’s point of view. DiGiovanni describes those videos as the appetizer, with the longer episodes serving as the entrée, giving audiences an opportunity to explore the professional kitchens and techniques behind the food. “Many viewers will find ‘Chef’ through one of our short-form videos, and the full episodes are there when they’re hungry for more,” he said. articles.title: ‘Dancing With the Stars’ Finale to Air Live Nationwide for First Time
articles.summary: The three-hour episode will close out Season 35 The post ‘Dancing With the Stars’ Finale to Air Live Nationwide for First Time appeared first on TheWrap .
articles.content: For the first time in the show’s history, “Dancing With the Stars” will air live nationwide for its finale next week. While “Dancing With the Stars” typically airs three hours later on the West Coast than its East Coast airing, the three-hour finale will air Tuesday, Nov. 24 live in every U.S. time zone for the first time in the show’s history. “Next week, it’s our massive three-hour season finale. For the first time ever, we will be live across the country on ABC and Disney Plus,” host Alfonso Ribeiro said during the live show for Tuesday’s semifinals. “That means viewers in the Mountain and Pacific time zones can vote when they watch. Watch live at 8 Eastern, 5 Pacific.” The finale will air live on Tuesday, Nov. 24, from 8-11 p.m. ET/7-10 p.m. CT/ 6-9 p.m. MT/5-8 p.m. PT on ABC and Disney+. The finale will also re-air at 8-11 p.m. PT and stream the next day on Hulu. The change up in airing times means that viewers will be able to vote live for their favorite couples as the finale unfolds and the finale five couples are narrowed down to one winning couple. The remaining couples will be tasked with completing three routines each, including the Judges’ Choice Dance, the return of the “Instant Dance Challenge” and an unforgettable Freestyle. Prior to the eliminations for Tuesday’s semifinals, the remaining couples include Harry Shum Jr. and Jenna Johnson, Amber Glenn and Pasha Pashkov, Maura Higgins and Mark Ballas, Ezra Frech and Daniella Karagac, Connor Wood and Rylee Arnold as well as Tatyana Ali and Jan Ravnik. Last week’s “Grammy Night” saw “Dancing With the Stars” hit a season viewership high of 6.91 million live-plus-same-day viewers — rising from 6.1 million viewers at the same point last season — as well as a 1.48 rating among adults 18-49 — rising from the 1.23 rating at the same point last season. “Dancing with the Stars” is produced in front of a live audience by BBC Studios Los Angeles Productions.

articles.title: Skydance Restructures Cable Division Naming 4 Executives to Lead Programming
articles.summary: Betsy Sanner Ayala, Jason Sarlanis, Tina Perry and Michael Ouweleen will oversee Skydance Global Cable Media, including BET, Comedy Central, Food Network and HGTV The post Skydance Restructures Cable Division Naming 4 Executives to Lead Programming appeared first on TheWrap .
articles.content: Betsy Sanner Ayala, Jason Sarlanis, Tina Perry and Michael Ouweleen will oversee Skydance Global Cable Media, including BET, Comedy Central, Food Network and HGTV Skydance restructured its cable division Tuesday, naming four executives to lead separate branches of the merged company’s more than 50 cable channels and properties. The mega media company formed Skydance Global Cable Media, which will include 50+ cable networks including Adult Swim, BET, Comedy Central, Discovery, Food Network, HGTV, ID, MTV, TLC and Nickelodeon. Channing Dungey, who oversees cable channels for the combined company, unveiled Skydance’s new leadership structure in a memo to staff Tuesday, naming four executives to lead unscripted lifestyle, broad-based entertainment, talent, music and live comedy and animation. Betsy Sanner Ayala, currently president and head of content for Food Network, will oversee unscripted lifestyle, including Discovery, HGTV and Magnolia. Joe Boyle will continue as head of content for Discovery, reporting to Sanner Ayala. Jason Sarlanis, currently president and head of content for TNT, TBS and ID, will oversee broad-based entertainment, adding TLC to his portfolio. Alon Orstein will continue as head of content for TLC, reporting to Sarlanis. Tina Perry, president and head of content for OWN, will oversee the talent, music and live division, adding MTV, VH1 and BET to her portfolio. Sitarah Pendelton will continue as head of content for MTV/VH1; Brian Rikuda will serve as head of BET; and Aisha Summers-Burke will continue as head of BET content. All three will report to Perry. All of Skydance’s animation properties will fall under a newly formed Skydance Television Animation, which includes Nickelodeon and Nickelodeon Animation Studios, Adult Swim, Cartoon Network, Warner Bros. articles.title: Thom Velde, Longtime AMC Theatres Film Buyer, Dies at 83
articles.summary: “Above all, he loved his family and friends, who will remember his strength of character, his generosity and the way he made time for the people in his life," his family says The post Thom Velde, Longtime AMC Theatres Film Buyer, Dies at 83 appeared first on TheWrap .
articles.content: “Above all, he loved his family and friends, who will remember his strength of character, his generosity and the way he made time for the people in his life,” his family says Thomas (Thom) Velde, who spent 27 years as head film buyer for AMC Theatres, died after a battle with cancer Oct. 31 in Rancho Mirage, Calif. surrounded by his family. He was 83. During his nearly three decades at AMC, Velde played a central role in the company’s relationships with the film industry, negotiating distribution agreements with domestic and international studios and helping determine the movies that would reach audiences across the theater chain. As head film buyer, he worked at the intersection of Hollywood’s studios and the exhibition business, navigating the agreements and partnerships that brought films from production and distribution to the big screen. His responsibilities extended well beyond film acquisition. Velde also oversaw AMC’s Canadian operations and its real estate ventures, taking on a broader role in the company’s business as it expanded its reach and managed its theater properties. His work gave him a wide-ranging perspective on the motion picture industry, from the business of securing films to the operations and infrastructure behind theatrical exhibition. After leaving AMC, Velde continued working in the industry independently, focusing on motion picture distribution and consulting. His clients included Microspace Communications and CJ America, allowing him to draw on decades of experience in film buying and distribution. Outside of work, Velde was an avid golfer and devoted college football fan. “Above all, he cherished his family and friends, who will remember his strength of character, generosity and commitment to staying connected with the people in his life,” his family said in a statement on his passing. “He was always willing to lend a hand and had a particular gift for keeping friendships alive over the years.” Velde is survived by his wife, Deborah; h

articles.content: “ Madden ” is technically a David O. Russell film , but all involved seem to want to downplay that fact. While the trailer includes an obligatory “From the director of ‘Silver Linings Playbook’ and ‘American Hustle’ ” title card, the poster features Cage and Christian Bale, who plays Oakland Raiders coach Al Davis, flashing their Super Bowl rings, and no mention of Russell. articles.title: ‘The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping’ Review: They Shoot Franchises, Don’t They?
articles.summary: Kidding, mostly, as this underwhelming sixth "Hunger Games" movie is about to make a hysterical amount of money.
articles.content: A grimmer, gloomier “ Hunger Games ” is on the horizon with “ Sunrise on the Reaping, ” adapted from Suzanne Collins’ prequel novel about the origin story of the hardened alcoholic Haymitch Abernathy. Here, the teenage version of Woody Harrelson’s character in the original films is played by Australian actor Joseph Zada, the blond, ringletted Adonis who also starred as the moody Cal Trask in the recent “ East of Eden ” series. Franchise fans might be riveted by Francis Lawrence’s latest installment — points for consistency, as he’s directed all the films dating back to 2013’s “Catching Fire” — but those audiences not already invested in the dystopian material and tales of tributes will find themselves left out in the cold by an overlong (it’s 158 minutes, so get comfortable), visually soupy, and narratively morose reprisal. But no matter, as this new slice of bankable I.P. is likely to rake in a hysterical amount of money, and perhaps launch Zada’s career as a face of new Hollywood stardom. Related Stories ‘The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth’ First Reactions: Quentin Tarantino and David Fincher Deliver a ‘Pure Riot’ of a Hangout Movie ‘Hershey’ Review: An Unbelievably Flavorless Biopic About America’s Most Famous Chocolatier The film is set during the 50th Hunger Games, otherwise known as the Second Quarter Quell. Only 16 years old, Haymitch is thrust into games that are rigged from the start — and whose broadcasting is ultimately edited and deepfaked to look like pro-Capitol propaganda. (The film nudges a little bit toward the ethics of state surveillance and how footage can be manipulated or even fabricated for political ends.) His pastoral, if impoverished, life in District 12 is small but happy, with girlfriend Lenore (Whitney Peak) and a mother and younger brother (Kara Tointon and Smylie Bradwell) with whom he shares close affinity, plus a best friend we’ll eventually find out will become the father of Katniss Everdeen (Lawrence) in the later films. articles.content: Ella Langley won nearly every award she was up for, including the top prize, as well as female vocalist and album, single and song of the year. Stephen Wilson Jr. was a surprise to many in being named best new artist. Taylor Swift sang her nominated song and presented a lifetime achievement award to Brooks & Dunn. In a near-sweep that surprised no one, Ella Langley won six trophies at the CMA Awards , including the top prize, entertainer of the year. That’s an all-time record for the most awards ever won in a year by one person. The “Choosin’ Texas” singer so swept the field that the show’s host, Lainey Wilson , came out with a broom during her final acceptance speech and pretended to be cleaning up the stage. “I watched these awards since i was a little kid, and the awards i cared most about were song of the year and entertainer of the year,” Langley said at the close. Ultimately, after five turns at the podium (the sixth award was announced pre-telecast), she said, “I’ve run out of things to say. I’m at a loss for words.” But, she finally added, “I could quit tomorrow and have the best year of my life.” Langley came in to the show with a leading nine nominations. It was only possible for her to win seven, since she was nominated against herself in two categories (single and song of the year, where “Choosin’ Texas” had “Be Her” as competition). She wound up winning almost everything she could have, with the lone exception of a nomination she shared for musical event of the year. Her sweep of the other six possible categories included wins for best female vocalist; album of the year for “Dandelion”; and, for her record-breaking “Choosin’ Texas,” a triple crown of single of the year, song of the year and music video of the year. articles.content: You might not always remember his name, but you know P.J. Byrne . A master of “hey, I love that guy!” roles, the actor is often classified as a scene-stealer, thanks to standout turns in everything from “The Wolf of Wall Street” and “Babylon” to “Coyote vs. Acme” and “The Rainmaker.” Byrne is funny, yes , but also energetic and an eager scene partner. He improves his projects not by simply showing up and grabbing some quick guffaws, but by really doing the work, learning his characters inside and out, and making it a priority to truly understand his directors. In his own words, he’s not stealing scenes; he’s elevating them. He doesn’t ever want to be the best thing in a film or show — he wants his process to help everything be better. articles.content: New York, New Jersey and Georgia are poised to reap the greatest benefit thanks to unlimited state tax credits. Hollywood studios are not banking on a U.S. tax incentive just yet. Though President Trump reaffirmed his support for the measure in a Truth Social post on Nov. 13, insiders say there is only a “narrow path” to approving the bill by the end of the year. Still, supporters are allowing themselves to dream about the potential effect if it does pass, using words like “massive” and “game changer.” Related Stories Need the Day Off to Play 'GTA 6'? Three states — New York, New Jersey and Georgia — offer generous film credits and stand to gain the most, according to several production executives who spoke to Variety . Producers love shooting in those states not because of the credit amount — but because credits are automatic. California has more production capacity — i.e., crews and stages — than anywhere else in the world and will benefit too, especially as work spills over from an overbooked New York. But it is not producers’ first choice, because it sticks to its $750 million incentive cap. Georgia has no limit on film rebates, and in New Jersey and New York, the caps are not enforced. New York’s program is budgeted at $800 million a year. But since making the formula more generous last year, the state has blown through that limit — handing out $1.7 billion in credits in the 12 months ending July 1. New Jersey’s program is also growing fast, and has $3 billion in reserves once the state completes deals with studio partners. articles.title: The 100 Greatest Movie Stars of All Time
articles.summary:
The 100 Greatest Movie Stars of All Time

The 100 Greatest Movie Stars of All Time
articles.content: We all know a movie star when we see one. But how can you tell which stars shine the brightest? Measuring the greatness of a movie star can be like catching lightning in a bottle. It’s a process that requires chemistry and finesse, as well as a search for the perfect mix — that fusion of artistry and popularity, history and currency that adds up to the incandescent ideal of stardom. Not every movie star is a great actor; not every great actor is a movie star. Many of the choices on our list reflect that. Yet there’s a magic zone where talent and luminescence fuse. And there’s another overlap that might be even more important: the one between the way these people pop onscreen and the way they dance in our dreams. To choose the 100 Greatest Movie Stars, we had to use our heads, our hearts, our guts, our fantasy lives. We were looking for the stars who magnetize us, the ones who awe and overpower us and make us swoon. The ones we wish we were, and the ones who inspire the ultimate movie-star thought: “That’s who I am.” His signature film was, by its very narrative design, an encapsulation of his virtues as a performer: In a room of 12 angry men, you could count on him to be the calmer, quieter one, a bastion of sense and reason. Upstanding integrity may not be the sexiest thing to be known for as a movie star, but Fonda was never stodgy with it. It’s fitting that Abraham Lincoln was one of his breakout roles, but it’s the urgently striving all-American masculinity of his Tom Joad in “The Grapes of Wrath” that really defined the Fonda aura, at least until his stubbornly humane Juror #8 came along. And the occasional, disorienting effect of his playing against type — bewildered doofus in “The Lady Eve,” ruthless villain in “Once Upon a Time in the West” — proved the strength of that type in the first place. — G.L. A letter initiated by the International Coalition for Filmmakers at Risk ( and shared with Variety ) so far features more than 200 signatories “deeply concerned by reports of the new prison sentence of five years and one month issued by the Tehran Revolutionary Court against Iranian filmmaker Jafar Panahi , in absentia.” Panahi returned to Iran in the spring following the end of Neon’s awards run for his Cannes Film Festival Palme d’Or winner “It Was Just an Accident,” nominated for Best International Feature and Best Original Screenplay at the 2026 Academy Awards. Festival leaders who signed the letter include Berlinale director Tricia Tuttle, New York Film Festival artistic director Dennis Lim, Venice’s Alberto Barbera, Telluride head Julie Huntsinger, and others — many of whom have hosted Panahi’s films across the last four decades. Previously, Panahi was sentenced to one year in prison and a two-year ban on leaving Iran in December, in absentia. The new October 2026 sentence carries additional penalties, as the letter notes, including confiscation of his assets, freezing of his bank accounts, a two-year travel ban, and a two-year social media ban. We broke that story, and now, we can tell you that the project has a director in Sean Wang , the Oscar nominee and Independent Spirit Award winner behind Focus Features’ Dìdi . Tessier-Lavigne resigned in the wake of this reporting, which made Baker the youngest-ever recipient of the prestigious George Polk Award. articles.title: Timothée Chalamet Addresses Possibility Of A ‘Call Me by Your Name’ Sequel: “Never Say Never”
articles.content: Nearly a decade later, a Call Me by Your Name sequel isn’t looking too likely, but another Luca Guadagnino / Timothée Chalamet team-up could be in the cards. The 4x Oscar-nominated actor recently commented on the possibility of the once-percolating sequel to Guadagnino’s 2017 adaptation of André Aciman’s 2007 novel happening, following co-star Armie Hammer’s fall from grace. “A great question,” he told Vanity Fair . “Never say never, but… I’ve grown up with the mindset that you don’t really go near something that is so near and dear to people. Chalamet added, “Now, to work with Luca again? In a heartbeat.” The pair last worked together on 2022’s Bones and All , which starred Chalamet and Taylor Russell. Watch on Deadline Set in 1983 rural Italy, Call Me by Your Name follows 17-year old Elio Perlman (Chalamet), who falls in love with Oliver (Hammer), a young graduate student who has been hired to assist Elio’s father (Stuhlbarg). In the heartbreaking conclusion, Oliver winds up returning to the United States at the end of the summer, breaking off his romance with Elio as he gets engaged to his girlfriend back home. Following the release of Aciman’s 2019 sequel novel Find Me , which picks up 10 years after the original, Guadagnino announced the following year that he was planning to adapt the followup with Chalamet, Hammer, Michael Stuhlbarg and more set to reprise their roles. The likelihood of the original cast reuniting seems to have gone out the window when the LAPD investigated accusations against Hammer of rape and sexual abuse in 2021. Although he was dropped from several projects and his representation, Hammer maintained his innocence and ultimately faced no charges .

Brosnan has first-hand experience of Pattinson’s abilities as an actor. “I have fond memories of our time together making ‘Remember Me,'” he continued, namechecking the 2010 film on which they worked together. “It has been a joy to watch you create a remarkable body of work and to go from strength to strength. Enjoy the ride.” Watch on Deadline Brosnan ended with a Gaelic sign of affection meaning “great love” as he wrote, “Grá mor, Pierce” Lazenby, whose outing as 007 began and ended with On Her Majesty’s Secret Service in 1969, also offered his congratulations and a remarkably similar piece of advice to that offered by Brosnan today: “Remember to enjoy yourself.” I hear they've announced the new James Bond @007 … Robert, welcome to the most exclusive club in the world. articles.title: Chris Pratt To Star In Paramount’s Feature Take Of Joseph Eckert Novel ‘The Traveler’
articles.content: Chris Pratt is set to headline Paramount Pictures ’ adaptation of The Traveler , based on the novel by Joseph Eckert. The project is part of the Guardians of the Galaxy star’s first-look three-year producing deal with the Melrose Ave lot through his Indivisible production banner, with the potential to star in select projects. Zach Lipovsky and Adam Stein are helming the feature off Justin Rhodes’ screenplay. The film will be produced by Adam Rosenberg and Jules Daly. Additional projects under Pratt’s deal include Miami Heat , written by Brad Copeland ( Jerry & Marge Go Large ), with Pratt set to star and produce alongside Hutch Parker ( Venom: The Last Dance ). Pratt’s movie canon counts more than $15 billion at the global box office. He can be seen this fall in Apple Original Films’ Way of the Warrior Kid , an adaptation of Jocko Willink’s bestselling children’s novel. It begins streaming November 25. He also stars in one of the five $1 billion-plus grossing movies of the year in Universal/Illumination’s Super Mario Galaxy Movie. Watch on Deadline Pratt also starred in TV’s The Terminal List , which premiered in July 2022. Based on the Jack Carr novel and produced through Indivisible Productions, the series debuted at No. 1 on Prime Video. The series was renewed for a second season and debuted October 21. A prequel series, Dark Wolf , led by Taylor Kitsch, premiered in August 2025.

articles.title: ‘Grendel’ Animated Series Based On Dark Horse Comic Greenlighted At Netflix
articles.content: EXCLUSIVE : Matt Wagner ‘s signature comic book character Hunter Rose is coming to the screen, this time for real. Netflix has ordered Grendel , an adult animated action series based on Wagner’s long-running comic book series published by Dark Horse . Bobak Esfarjani ( Widow’s Bay, WandaVision, Alien: Earth ) is writer, executive producer and showrunner on the TV adaptation. In it, after the woman he loves is shockingly murdered, Hunter Rose devotes himself to one thing: vengeance. But as he tears through street gangs, the elite, and New York City’s supernatural underworld in pursuit of her killer, a chance at a real life forces him to choose: walk away from ultimate power, or become the very monster he hunts. Related Stories News 'Ginny & Georgia' Season 4 Premiere Date Set By Netflix With First-Look Photos Video Games 'Grand Theft Auto VI' Turns Chaos & Crime Into Cash & Clout With Record-Shattering Launch Esfarjani executive produces with Chris Tongue, Tim Wiesch and Jay Komas for Dark Horse Entertainment ( The Umbrella Academy ), Lydia Antonini ( Locke and Key, Halo: Forward Unto Dawn ); and Wagner ( Dead Boy Detectives ). Bobbypills ( Creature Commandos, Captain Laserhawk ) is the studio. Watch on Deadline “It’s incredibly exciting to see my creation finally make this leap to the animated screen! Netflix’s dynamic new series retains the source material’s dark adult themes and also brings a fresh and thrilling approach to the narrative,” Wagner said. “This is Grendel as I’ve always wanted to see the character portrayed — a hyper-kinetic level of action, bracing explosions of violence and a poignant engaging storyline.” Netflix previously ordered a live-action Grendel series in 2021 as part of the streamer’s first-look deal with Dark Horse Entertainment, with Andrew Dabb as writer/executive producer, Abubakr Ali in the titular role and Jaime Ray Newman and Erik Palladino among the rest of the cast. A year later, Netflix opted not to move forward with the series .

articles.title: ‘American Idol’ Gets Rid Of Hollywood Week In Favor Of More Live Shows As ABC Music Competition Moves To Georgia: “Major Changes Coming”
articles.content: EXCLUSIVE : When Gladys Knight sang “Midnight Train to Georgia” on the season six finale of American Idol , backed by Ben Stiller, Jack Black and Robert Downey Jr., nobody thought that 20 years later the team behind the show would be taking her lyrics so literally. L.A. proved too much for the show, it seems, as the ABC music competition takes its live shows to the suburbs of Atlanta for the first time in its 25-year history. Deadline revealed in September that the Ryan Seacrest-hosted show would be relocating, but it is only one of a number of changes to the show as it heads into Season 25 (or Season 10 on ABC). The other major change to Idol is that there is a surprising new path to America’s Vote as the show eschews Hollywood Week for the first time. Watch on Deadline Contestants will no longer be heading to Hollywood (or Nashville, as it was last season), but instead judges Luke Bryan, Lionel Richie and Carrie Underwood will award 25 Golden Tickets, sending hopefuls straight to Hawaii. “This is a major departure, major changes coming,” American Idol showrunner Megan Michaels Wolflick told Deadline ahead of its return on Monday, February 8, 2027. By cutting out Hollywood Week, American Idol can get to the live shows quicker. The show will kick off with three audition episodes, followed by two shows in Hawaii before going live. “The auditions and the live shows are the bread and butter for this show and the process of a Hollywood Week is really a culling process that we were televising,” Michaels Wolflick added. “Going to America’s Vote is what this show is about. Hollywood was a metaphor.” The move essentially allows viewers to vote on their favorites earlier. It coincides with the 25th anniversary, hopefully giving it a Survivor 50 -style celebration. Michaels Wolflick is known for regularly freshening up the format over the years, for instance, becoming the first major competition show to introduce social voting last season. “It keeps people on their toes,” she

articles.content: Ella Langley took home six CMA Awards tonight, including Entertainer of the Year, Female Vocalist of the Year, Single of the Year, Music Video of the Year and Song of the Year for “Choosin’ Texas,” and Album of the Year for Dandelion . articles.title: Larry Poindexter Dies: ‘S.W.A.T.’, ‘JAG’ & ‘Days Of Our Lives’ Actor Was 66
articles.content: Larry Poindexter , a veteran character actor who has appeared in almost 200 movies and TV series, passed away today, Nov. 18, four and a half days after being hit by a car. He was 66. Poindexter was struck while crossing the street to pick up food in his Studio City neighborhood Friday night. He had been at the hospital and scheduled to have a surgery for broken ribs today when he died suddenly this morning. Poindexter, whose career spanned more than four decades, is known for his role in the 2003 film S.W.A.T. in which he played by-the-book LAPD Captain Tom Fuller, who went head-to-head with Samuel Jackson’s Hondo. On TV, Poindexter appeared in 30 episodes of daytime drama Days Of Our Lives , playing two different characters, first in 1984 as Ben Welch, and as Father Louis from 2014-2018. He also did a 23-episode stint on Santa Barbara and 12 episodes of General Hospital . In primetime, Poindexter was a series regular on the MTV comedy series The Hard Times of RJ Berger and had a major recurring role on CBS’ JAG . He was a guest star on dozens of shows over the years, including playing Sergeant Boyer in the S.W.A.T. TV series and appearing in episodes of Quantum Leap, NYPD Blue, How I Met Your Mother, Friends, NCIS, Will & Grace, Scandal, CSI, CSI: Miami, CSI: NY, Party of Five, Nip/Tuck, Melrose Place, Weeds, Californication, Hawaii Five-0, Castle, Curb Your Enthusiasm, Supernatural, Bones, All Rise, Station 19, The Rookie, and 9-1-1. His most recent guest appearance was in Season 4 of The Lincoln Lawyer earlier this year. Also a musician, Poindexter was lead singer for the alternative country band The High Lonesome in the 1990s. Their album Feel Free To Do So was released in 1995. Poindexter is survived by his wife, leading casting director Carol Kritzer, and their two sons. Larry was one of the kindest and gracious guys around. Talented and affable always. I am so devastated to lose him he was one of the best. So much love to his family. I’m so very sorry for yo

articles.title: ‘Yaga’ Creator Wanted To Sexualize Men “The Way Female Bodies Are Looked At” In Thriller Genre
articles.content: As the dark mystery at the center of Yaga unfolds, the Crave series has turned up the steam with some guy-on-guy scenes. Series creator Kat Sandler explained that “it definitely was a choice” to have “objectified” Charlie ( Noah Reid ) and Henry ( Hudson Williams ) in the episode “The Horns,” in the same “way that female bodies are looked at” in the thriller genre. “We’re presenting these two stunning men in this way that you’re used to seeing women,” said Sandler on the show’s official podcast . “You look at Basic Instinct —it’s not the same thing—but it’s a choice to look at male bodies in this show the way that female bodies are looked at it thrillers and in horrors and in mysteries, repeatedly,” she added. “So, it was definitely a choice, but I stand by that it’s important to the story.” Watch on Deadline In Yaga , private investigator Charlie Rapp (Reid) is hired to find Henry Park (Williams), the heir to a commercial fishery who has gone missing, while suspicion grows around Dr. Katherine Hargrove (Carrie-Anne Moss), a university professor with an interest in the Slavic witch legend Baba Yaga. New episodes of Yaga are available to stream Fridays on Crave in Canada and AMC+ in the US, with the final two episodes set for Nov. 27.

articles.title: David Ellison Goes Personal: Raised By Single Mom, Bonded With Dad As Teen, Massive VHS Collection
articles.content: “I was raised by a single mother, by my mom. My parents got divorced when I was 3, and I really started building my relationship with my father when I was 13 years old through aviation,” said David Ellison , getting a bit more personal than usual at the New York Times DealBook Summit on Wednesday. “You didn’t have a relationship with your father till you were 13?” asked moderator Andrew Ross Sorkin. “We saw each other, you know, once a year, every other year. We couldn’t be closer now. I want to be clear. We really built a phenomenal relationship through aviation. We started flying model airplanes” then graduated to real planes. “Basically, we learned how to fly together, and kind of the weekend ritual was every Saturday, every Sunday, I’d go do an hour of flight training. He’d be on the ground and study. He’d go do an hour of flight training, I’d be on the ground and study.” Watch on Deadline Ellison said he traveled to air shows across the country, including Oshkosh [Air Show] – “which, for those who don’t know, is kind of like the Super Bowl of aviation events … It was an incredible thing to get to do in early life.” He was aware of his tech lord father’s status but “my parents definitely made a concerted effort to make sure that we had a really grounded and normal childhood.” The younger Ellison fell in love with movies and storytelling as a kid going to the cinema every single weekend. “By the way, my father loves film as well. But you know, it was really something the three of us kind of all loved growing up,” he said, referring to his mother and his sister Megan Ellison, founder and CEO of Annapurna Pictures. “Literally, we had, I still have it, a VHS collection that was like 3,000 [tapes]. We used to joke it was like Blockbuster at home. And Sunday was the one day, when you were a kid, when you can kind of do whatever you wanted. And me and Megan would be like, let’s watch all five Rocky movies, or, you know, let’s watch the Star Wars trilogy.” David Ellison

articles.content: Chief Marketing Officer Rebecca Mall is the latest member of Skydance co-CEOs David Ellison and Ynon Kreiz’s senior leadership team to unveil the structure of her unit a month after the completion of the Paramount-Warner Bros. articles.title: Jason Blum and James Wan Discuss Why Horror Is Hollywood’s Hottest Genre and How ‘Obsession’ Hit Big at Blumhouse Atomic’s Business of Fear
articles.content: Blumhouse Atomic bosses Jason Blum and James Wan took a victory lap Wednesday at their Business of Fear panel, during which they discussed horror’s banner year at the box office and why “ Obsession ” became the breakout hit of the summer. But before the horror talk began, they had to address the name change. Blum’s Blumhouse and Wan’s Atomic Monster merged in 2024, and the combined labels were therefore known as Blumhouse Atomic Monster. Recently, in early November , Blumhouse Atomic Monster rebranded to just Blumhouse Atomic. Blum explained they rebranded to give a more definitive identity to the overarching banner of the two companies, while also clearing the way for both distinct labels to take credit for their work. Related Stories Taylor Swift’s Canceled Vienna Concerts Due to Thwarted Terrorist Plot to Be Subject of Documentary Taylor Swift Ties Grammy Record for Consecutive Album of the Year Nominations “As Jason pointed out, it really still is Blumhouse movies and Atomic Monster movies,” Wan added. “We’re still making the movies as one company, but still under two labels. We put out a bunch of movies, and so we have to sort of divide it. Some movies play better at Atomic Monster, some movies play better at Blumhouse. At the start of movies, even though it’s going to say Blumhouse Atomic Presents, our logos will still stand individually.” It was then on to horror’s stellar year. Moderator Ray Subers, head of film at NRG, presented Blum and Wan with a stat that theater attendance for horror films in 2026 went up 7% from pre-pandemic levels, while attendance for all other genre films (action, sci-fi, rom-coms) decreased. Blum theorized this was because watching horror on the big screen is “participatory,” and that audiences craved a “collective experience” after emerging from COVID lockdown. “I think that after COVID, audiences ran back to sporting events and ran back to concerts, but they had been fed movies,” Blum said. “Kids had been fed movies so much at ho

articles.title: Why ‘GTA’ Has Never Been Adapted for Film or TV: ‘We Prefer to Control Our Own Destiny,’ Take-Two CEO Says
articles.content: With this week’s debut of “ Grand Theft Auto 6” widely considered to be the entertainment event of the decade , the Rockstar Games-created franchise seems like an obvious target for a Hollywood adaptation. But those producers hoping to land the rights could be waiting indefinitely, as Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick has said for years that the company is not interested. “We’re very careful about line extensions because this is a creative company and our goal is to make the best entertainment on earth. Entertainment we’re always proud of,” Zelnick said in an interview on The David Rubenstein Show Nov. 12. “We would make a movie or television show based on our intellectual property if our creative teams were passionate about it. If they thought that would somehow engage and delight our consumers. It’s a high bar to do that. And of course, there’s always a risk of failure. So we don’t rule it out, but we’re very, very selective.” Related Stories 'Wolfenstein 3' in Development at Xbox's MachineGames Need the Day Off to Play 'GTA 6'? Xbox and DJ Khaled's 'Dr. Xbox' Have a PTO Excuse Note for You Zelnick isn’t being coy here, as he’s provided the same answer for years now when asked about the possibility of adapting “ GTA ” for film or TV. In August 2024, the Take-Two Interactive told Variety the Rockstar Games owner has “selectively licensed intellectual properties” and “the value of those licenses is typically not all that significant, even in great success.” Beginning with its first title released in 1997, Rockstar Games’ “Grand Theft Auto” franchise is comprised of six mainline titles, as of the release of “ GTA 6 ” on Friday. The games are known for their M rating, extreme violence and criminal activity, largely in the form of committing grand theft auto. For “GTA 6,” the franchise is pushing the boundaries of the open-world genre with the immersive story of Jason and Lucia, a Bonnie-and-Clyde-style criminal duo running on the streets of the fictional Vice C

articles.title: Pierce Brosnan Welcomes Robert Pattinson Into the James Bond Family: ‘You Are Going to Be Magnificent’
articles.content: Pierce Brosnan , a former James Bond himself, has taken to social media to enthusiastically endorse the newly anointed Robert Pattinson , who was announced as the new 007 on Monday. “Dear Robert, Welcome to the world of Bond,” Brosnan, who played the character in four films from 1995 to 2002, wrote on Instagram Wednesday. “You are going to be magnificent. I have fond memories of our time together making ‘Remember Me.’ It has been a joy to watch you create a remarkable body of work and to go from strength to strength. Enjoy the ride. Grá mor, Pierce.” Related Stories How to Watch the CMA Awards (And Taylor Swift's Performance) Live Online Ella Langley Breaks a CMA Awards Record by Winning Six in One Night, Including Entertainer of the Year: The Complete List of Winners As the “Parent Trap” actor noted in his caption, the two stars first worked together on 2010’s “Remember Me,” a romantic drama also starring Emilie de Ravin and Meghan Markle. With his statement, Brosnan joins stars including Pattinson’s “Tenet” co-star Elizabeth Debicki and former Bond villain Rami Malek in congratulating the “Twilight” actor on securing the role. Pattinson’s announcement as the next Bond put an end to long-swirling rumors surrounding which actor would step into the role. Other stars in the mix included Callum Turner, Jack Lowden, Nicholas Hoult, Josh O’Connor, Tom Francis, Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Harris Dickinson and even Harry Styles. Denis Villeneuve will direct the forthcoming film from Amazon MGM. Before the casting news broke, Brosnan told The Times in September that he thought the new James Bond would be “someone that none of us know about.” He had also noted that “there are lots of good hats in the ring” and “lots of great actors” being considered. When it came to names, Brosnan remained neutral: “I wouldn’t pick anyone,” he continued. “My wife told me not to say anything, and I’ve said too much. Because once I say something it goes [everywhere] and I get hanged.”

articles.title: Michelle Monaghan and Justin Theroux to Star in ‘Sleepover’ From Blumhouse Atomic and Universal
articles.content: Michelle Monaghan and Justin Theroux are set to star in “Sleepover” from Blumhouse Atomic and Universal Pictures. articles.title: Willa, Women Make Movies Team to Release Shalini Kantayya’s Doc ‘Love Apptually’ Theatrically
articles.content: Willa and Women Make Movies have teamed up to distribute documentary “ Love Apptually ,” theatrically in the U.S. Set for a February released timed to Valentine’s Day, “Love Apptually,” directed by Shalini Kantayya, follows French journalist Judith Duportail’s journey from her early fascination with Tinder to an investigation into the technologies and business incentives mediating our search for human connection. After uncovering Tinder’s hidden desirability rating system, Duportail demanded access to her personal data, ultimately receiving 800 pages of information collected by the platform. What begins as a personal curiosity evolves into a global investigation into how a multi-billion-dollar tech industry is quietly reshaping desire, intimacy and love. Kantayya digs into how dating platforms are designed to maximize engagement and profit, often at the expense of authentic human connection. The film raises questions about agency, autonomy, privacy, and the commercialization of human intimacy. “I’ve watched Big Tech move from capturing our attention to shaping our most intimate human relationships. ‘Love Apptually’ asks whether the loneliness epidemic is a consequence of technological design,” said director Shalini Kantayya. The film bowed at Hot Docs and also recently screened at DOC NYC. “Love Apptually” marks the final installment in Kantayya’s trilogy examining technology’s impact on human experience, following “Coded Bias” and “TikTok, Boom.,” which both premiered at Sundance, screened on PBS’s Independent Lens and received Emmy nominations. “Valentine’s Day is a time when we celebrate love, but ‘Love Apptually’ asks us to look more closely at the forces shaping how we find it,” said Elizabeth Woodward, founder and CEO of Willa and producer of the film. “Shalini has created a film that reveals how technology has moved beyond capturing our attention to influencing our most intimate relationships. We’re excited to bring the film to audiences at a moment when thes

articles.title: Darren Aronofsky’s Protozoa and Memory to Adapt Chris Miller’s ‘Chip War’ into Feature Documentary (EXCLUSIVE)
articles.content: Chris Miller’s book “Chip War: The Fight for the World’s Most Critical Technology” is being adapted into a feature documentary from Darren Aronofsky ‘s Protozoa and Memory, Variety can reveal exclusively. “All Light, Everywhere” filmmaker Theo Anthony will direct the film. Producers include Riel Roch-Decter and Anthony for Memory, and Aronofsky, Dylan Golden and Brendan Naylor for Protozoa. Executive producers are Jessica Harrop for Sandbox Films, Jenny Raskin for Impact Partners and Rachel Crane for Cranium Productions. CAA Media Finance, which arranged financing for the film, represents its worldwide distribution rights. Related Stories Taylor Swift and Karlie Kloss Reunite at Travis Kelce’s Chiefs Game Against Jets Bill Maher Fires Back at Trump by Comparing Him to Taylor Swift According to an official description, the “Chip War” doc will explore “the semiconductor industry, the vast and largely invisible supply chain that makes the chips inside every phone, weapon and AI model, along with the escalating struggle between the United States and China to control it. Amid political upheaval, corporate scandal and a wave of upcoming AI IPOs, the race for chips has never been more urgent.” “The story of silicon and the people who shaped and are shaping it is the story of our time. When I read Chris’ brilliant book, I knew it had to find more audiences with moving images. Who better to bring it to life than the absolute original filmmaking of Theo Anthony?” Aronofsky said. Anthony made his feature debut in 2016 with “Rat Film,” an experimental doc about the rat infestation in Baltimore, which helps tell a bigger story about classism and racism in the city. He followed that project with his 2019 “30 for 30” film “Subject to Review,” chronicling the rise of the instant replay system in professional tennis. His last documentary, “All Light, Everywhere,” premiered at Sundance 2021 and won the special jury prize for nonfiction experimentation.

articles.title: ‘GTA 6’ Earns Rave Reviews and Lands 99 Metacritic Score, Tying for Highest-Rated Game of All Time
articles.content: The review embargo on “Grand Theft Auto VI” has finally lifted and the game, which on Tuesday was nominated for Game of the Year ahead of its launch, is considered Rockstar Games’ latest masterpiece. “ GTA 6 ” currently holds a score of 99 on Metacritic , which ties it with the original 1998 Nintendo 64 version of “The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time” for the highest-rated video game of all time on the platform. (The recently released remake of “Ocarina of Time” for Switch 2 has a score of 96 on Metacritic and is also a 2026 Game of the Year contender.) Related Stories Taylor Swift’s Canceled Vienna Concerts Due to Thwarted Terrorist Plot to Be Subject of Documentary Taylor Swift Performs 'I Knew It, I Knew You' and 'Our Song' Mashup at CMA Awards “Many superlatives will be heard in the discussion around ‘ Grand Theft Auto VI ‘ – biggest world, most activities, best graphics, deepest narrative – but its real triumph is the way all those features and others work in service of a cohesive, believable immersion in a criminal fantasy that is hard to grasp until you’ve played it for yourself,” Game Informer’s Matt Miller wrote in his review, which gave the game a perfect score of 10. Thirteen years in the making , “GTA 6” is a massive open-world game that follows protagonists Jason Duval and Lucia Camino (voiced by Manni L. Perez) who find themselves stuck in the midst of a criminal conspiracy in the fictional state of Leonida after a score goes wrong. “Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos are an interesting pair of playable characters, and unlike any leads that have come before them in the series,” Luke Reilly wrote for IGN . “Their motivations and goals are very different from the main characters of previous ‘GTA’ games, and their priority is really about escape rather than revenge or empire building. They’re not angels, and it is invariably their recklessness as small-time crooks that puts them in the wrong place at the wrong time, but the overall sliminess of their far more

articles.title: Florence Pugh Fires Back at Video Claiming She Used Plastic Surgery to Change Her Face: ‘Disturbing’ How ‘People Can’t Tell the Difference Between…
articles.content: Florence Pugh is shutting down speculation over whether or not she’s had plastic surgery done to her face. The Oscar nominee left a comment on an Instagram video posted by Evie magazine in which she called it “disturbing” how people can no longer tell the difference between natural aging and plastic surgery. The video called into question whether or not Pugh changed her face shape by going under the knife. “Guys. I turned 30. I’m a woman. Body’s and faces change. It’s not that deep,” Pugh wrote. “The fact that people can’t even tell between what’s aging and what’s surgery is disturbing. Sadly puppy fluff doesn’t last forever.” Related Stories Taylor Swift to Perform at CMAs for the First Time in 13 Years Ella Langley Breaks a CMA Awards Record by Winning Six in One Night, Including Entertainer of the Year: The Complete List of Winners In the video posted by Evie magazine , a female commenter is superimposed in front of two pictures of Pugh that are used to show how plastic surgery might’ve changed the actor’s face shape. “Is this a safe space? People are saying Florence Pugh has fallen victim to Hollywood’s war on round faces,” the Evie commentator says. “Don’t get me wrong, Florence Pugh still looks beautiful, but I think we can all collectively agree that Hollywood seems to have this thing against softer features. The desirable thing in the entertainment industry and the modeling industry right now is this sculpted, snatched looked. A lot of people are pointing out how Florence used to have full, beautiful cheeks that made her face super recognizable. Now that her jaw is more defined, her chin is pointier and her jaw is more sharp, it makes sense why people are wondering if she had work done.” The commentator added later in the video, “What hurts me the most about this is young women seeing [Pugh’s face] and thinking, ‘Oh, my naturally soft features are something that need to be fixed and its undesirable.'” Pugh expanded on her thoughts in a standalone Instagram p

articles.title: Newsmax Fears Fox Freeze-Out on Roku if Merger Is Not Blocked
articles.content: Newsmax filed an antitrust lawsuit on Thursday that seeks to block the Fox- Roku merger, arguing that the deal gives Fox unlawful monopoly power over the free streaming market. Fox Corp. closed the $22 billion acquisition earlier this month. The Department of Justice cleared the deal the same day, announcing that Fox had made commitments to keep Roku as an “open and neutral” platform. Related Stories CMA Awards Predictions: Expect Ella Langley to Get Everything but Male Vocalist, and Maybe Even That's Not Safe Ella Langley Breaks a CMA Awards Record by Winning Six in One Night, Including Entertainer of the Year: The Complete List of Winners But in its lawsuit , Newsmax alleges that those commitments are unenforceable, and raises fears that Fox will deprive it of a key distribution channel. “No single media company should have the power to determine which news voices Americans can see or hear,” said Christopher Ruddy, the CEO of Newsmax, in a statement. “Fox already dominates cable news and has repeatedly sought to undermine Newsmax as a competitor. Now Fox wants to control the very platforms and technology that millions of Americans use to access news and information.” According to the complaint, Fox will control some 70% of the free, ad-supported streaming TV market through its ownership of Roku and Tubi . “Fox has a long history of anticompetitive animus toward Newsmax,” the lawsuit states. “Most notably, Fox has refused to carry Newsmax on Fox’s own free streaming service, Tubi. Now that Fox has acquired Roku – along with (the Roku Channel) – the risk that Fox will further degrade distribution of Newsmax’s content is clear.” “Newsmax’s complaint, which comes after a rigorous review process by regulatory agencies, is wholly without merit,” a Fox spokesperson said. “Upon closing, we commenced actively integrating this approved transaction for the benefit of consumers, partners and other stakeholders.” Newsmax filed a separate antitrust suit against Fox last year in

articles.title: Ella Langley Breaks a CMA Awards Record by Winning Six in One Night, Including Entertainer of the Year: The Complete List of Winners
articles.content: Ella Langley won nearly every award she was up for, including the top prize, as well as female vocalist and album, single and song of the year. Stephen Wilson Jr. was a surprise to many in being named best new artist. Taylor Swift sang her nominated song and presented a lifetime achievement award to Brooks & Dunn. In a near-sweep that surprised no one, Ella Langley won six trophies at the CMA Awards , including the top prize, entertainer of the year. That’s an all-time record for the most awards ever won in a year by one person. The “Choosin’ Texas” singer so swept the field that the show’s host, Lainey Wilson , came out with a broom during her final acceptance speech and pretended to be cleaning up the stage. “I watched these awards since i was a little kid, and the awards i cared most about were song of the year and entertainer of the year,” Langley said at the close. Ultimately, after five turns at the podium (the sixth award was announced pre-telecast), she said, “I’ve run out of things to say. I’m at a loss for words.” But, she finally added, “I could quit tomorrow and have the best year of my life.” Langley came in to the show with a leading nine nominations. It was only possible for her to win seven, since she was nominated against herself in two categories (single and song of the year, where “Choosin’ Texas” had “Be Her” as competition). She wound up winning almost everything she could have, with the lone exception of a nomination she shared for musical event of the year. Her sweep of the other six possible categories included wins for best female vocalist; album of the year for “Dandelion”; and, for her record-breaking “Choosin’ Texas,” a triple crown of single of the year, song of the year and music video of the year. (Scroll down to see the complete list of winners.) Langley was joined on stage for all her wins by fellow country superstar Miranda Lambert, who also drew a big haul of honors, as an executive producer of the “Dandelion” album and co-writer a

articles.title: As U.S. Infrastructure Crumbles, ABC’s ‘World News Tonight’ Posts Highest Week-Long Daily Ratings Since COVID
articles.content: A week after the midterm elections generated tremendous audiences for the network evening newscasts, last week’s unpredictable string of news — including the Microsoft Outlook blackout, followed by the nationwide grounding of air flights — propelled ABC’s “ World News Tonight ” to heights the telecast hasn’t seen in years. The busy news week also included the Nvidia scandal, the Brooklyn building collapse, the Pete Hegseth impeachment vote, fallout from the midterm elections (and late-breaking results like Mississippi’s Sen.-elect Scott Colom) and more. Related Stories Taylor Swift's CMA Return Helped Disney Sell More Ads As CMA Awards Prepare 60th Annual Telecast, Retiring CEO Sarah Trahern Prepares for Her Exit, and Looks Back on Decades of Prime-Time Highlights According to ABC News, “World News Tonight” averaged more than 9 million Total Viewers on each of its five telecasts last week — the first time it has done that in nearly six years, during the COVID era (specifically, the week of Feb. 15, 2021). “Audiences are turning to ‘World News Tonight with David Muir ’ in numbers we haven’t seen since the COVID pandemic, a powerful reflection of the trust they place in our journalism during uncertain times,” said ABC News president Almin Karamehmedovic in a statement to Variety . “Amid a relentless week of breaking news, culminating in Friday’s nationwide ground stop, more than 9 million Americans tuned in every single night. We are deeply grateful for their confidence and never take that responsibility for granted.” Over the entire week (except for Monday, which wasn’t included due to Monday Night Football), “World News Tonight with David Muir” was No. 1 with total viewers (9.251 million) on all of broadcast and cable (excluding sports) for the second week in a row and landed its best number in four years, according to Nielsen’s Live+Same Day Big Data Plus Panel Program Ratings. “World News Tonight with David Muir” was also No. 1 with adults 25-54 (1.366 million) an

articles.title: Rola Bauer, Executive Producer on Robin Wright’s ‘The Girlfriend,’ Joins Monte-Carlo Television Festival as Creative Director
articles.content: Seasoned TV producer Rola Bauer , the executive producer on Robin Wright’s “The Girlfriend,” has been appointed creative director of the Monte-Carlo Television Festival . Bauer will oversee the festival’s international strategy and lead its advisory board. She will play “a key role in shaping the festival’s programming, developing relationships with leading international talent and audiovisual industry partners, as well as identifying and developing strategic opportunities, particularly in the U.S. and the U.K.,” the festival said. Related Stories Taylor Swift to Perform at CMAs for the First Time in 13 Years Ella Langley Breaks a CMA Awards Record by Winning Six in One Night, Including Entertainer of the Year: The Complete List of Winners Bauer most recently served as head of pan-English scripted TV at Amazon MGM Studios and president of international television at MGM Studios, where she championed, produced or oversaw hits including “The Girlfriend,” “Steal,” “Bait,” “Harlan Coben’s Shelter” and “Harlan Coben’s Lazarus,” in addition to establishing co-financing structures for “Billy the Kid” and “From.” As a founding partner of Tandem Communications, later renamed StudioCanal TV following the company’s acquisition by Canal+ Group, she pioneered the complex co-production structures that now define prestige international television. She produced or shepherded global series including “The Pillars of the Earth,” “ZeroZeroZero,” “Crossing Lines,” “The Stranger,” “Years and Years,” “The Man Who Fell to Earth” and “War of the Worlds,” among others. Her relationship with the festival dates back more than a decade, beginning with the presentation of “Crossing Lines” at the opening of the 2013 edition. Since then, she has regularly brought international talent and premieres to Monaco, including “Last Light” in 2022 and “Harlan Coben’s Shelter” in 2023. In 2026, she became a member of the festival’s advisory board. The festival has also appointed seven new advisory board amb

articles.title: African TV Giant Primedia Acquires The Africa Channel and Assets, Expanding its Reach Across the Continent and in U.S.
articles.content: Primedia, Africa’s leading producer and distributor of television content, has acquired The Africa Channel , one of the few Black-owned U.S. media companies dedicated to creating content for African audiences. The deal combines The Africa Channel’s Los Angeles-based media businesses with Primedia’s media content production, advertiser relationships and distribution capabilities across the continent of Africa. Related Stories Taylor Swift Ties Grammy Record for Consecutive Album of the Year Nominations Bill Maher Fires Back at Trump by Comparing Him to Taylor Swift Primedia plans to invest in TAC’s next phase of growth by expanding worldwide distribution of its linear, FAST and digital services, increasing development and production of original content and building a broader global media brand for audiences of African content around the world. The pact gives Primedia its first owned-and-operated U.S. television network and streaming platform outside of Africa. TAC’s media assets being acquired include Demand Africa, a streaming platform available as an SVOD/AVOD app, as well as a free, ad-supported streaming television (FAST) channel; TAC Studios, the in-house studio that develops and produces original content; TAC Labs, an AI-driven innovation team that has developed projects for the entertainment and media market with plans to collaborate with Primedia. “The combination of Primedia’s talent pool and the brilliant team at The Africa Channel brings together an established U.S. platform with Primedia’s tech stack, production, commercial and distribution strength,” Jonathan Procter, group CEO of Primedia, said. “Together, we intend to build a business that can move African news, sports, content, talent and brands more effectively between continents while creating new opportunities across distribution, advertising and content ownership.” Paula Williams Madison, currently TAC’s principal owner, will become the chair of the advisory board. articles.title: ‘Furious’ Creator Elizabeth Meriwether to Receive ATX TV Festival’s 2027 Showrunner Award
articles.content: Elizabeth Meriwether is set to receive the 2027 Showrunner Award at next year’s ATX Television Festival, Variety has learned. Meriwether will take part in a conversation onstage at the festival, which runs June 3-6, 2027, in Austin, TX. It will be her first time appearing at the festival. The Showrunner Award is meant to recognize those who “foster an environment of collaboration and creativity in their role as showrunner, and whose creative voice has a singular and expansive influence on TV,” per the official description. Past recipients include David E. Kelley and Bill Lawrence. Related Stories 'Furious' Creator Elizabeth Meriwether to Receive ATX TV Festival's 2027 Showrunner Award Saudi Arabia's Red Sea Film Festival Forges 'Strategic' Partnership With Cairo Film Festival “ ATX TV Festival is such a special gathering of people who truly love television and truly love Texas BBQ, and I am deeply grateful for this honor,” Meriwether said. Meriwether most recently created and served as showrunner on the Hulu series “Furious” which starred Emmy Rossum as an FBI agent hunting a serial killer played by Lola Petticrew. The show was loosely inspired by the 1987 film “Black Widow” and was renewed for a second season in August . Meriwether is also known creating the hit Fox single-cam comedy “New Girl,” which ran for seven seasons. She is also behind the Emmy-winning Hulu liminted series “The Dropout” starring Amanda Seyfried, which delved into the life and career of Elizabeth Holmes. Her other credits include the acclaimed series “Dying for Sex” at FX. “From the pure joy of ‘New Girl,’ to the righteous anger of ‘Furious,’ to the sharp surreality and cultural relevance of ‘The Dropout,’ there are few writers in television that are willing – and able – to consistently challenge our expectations in the way that Liz’s stories do,” said Jenn Morgan, head of programming for the ATX TV Festival. “As a showrunner, she continues to prove that creative risks are worth taking, and t

articles.title: How NBC’s Longtime Page Program Has Served as a Key Stepping Stone to Media Leadership
articles.content: Katie Hockmeyer now oversees “Saturday Night Live” as NBC’s executive vice president of late night. But she still can’t forget her first brush with the sketch comedy staple: As an NBC page assigned to the floor. That’s right, Hockmeyer was a real-life Kenneth the Page, just like the one played by Jack McBrayer at the “TGS” production offices on “30 Rock.” In 2002, Hockmeyer was the NBC desk page at “SNL,” right when it was populated by some of the show’s all-time greats — including Tina Fey (who eventually created “30 Rock”), Maya Rudolph, Jimmy Fallon, Amy Poehler, Fred Armisen and Will Forte. Related Stories Taylor Swift Ties Grammy Record for Consecutive Album of the Year Nominations Taylor Swift Performs 'I Knew It, I Knew You' and 'Our Song' Mashup at CMA Awards “It was incredible,” she says. One of her duties was to escort that week’s guest host around 30 Rock. “I remember walking Mick Jagger from down in the basement up to Lorne Michaels’ office as a page. The idea that someone would say, ‘I designate you to walk Mick Jagger’ is so crazy to me! But they trust you to learn to be professional out of the gate. Honestly, it was an amazing experience, and I learned very quickly that I like being in a live environment with comedians.” Hockmeyer clearly impressed the “SNL” team: After her stint as a page was over, she was asked to interview as one of Michaels’ assistants. She got the job — and eventually worked her way up to running the entire late night department at NBC. “I only hire pages,” she says. “It’s the best post-collegiate program. You talk about the history of company. You basically meet everyone in the building. The access that you have is pretty incredible.” Hockmeyer is one of many success stories to come out of the NBC page program. articles.title: Comedian Morgan Jay Launches ‘Music Therapy’ Show With Guests Kam Patterson, Josh Johnson and More (EXCLUSIVE)
articles.content: Morgan Jay , the stand-up comedian best known for his viral auto-tuned crowd-work songs, has launched a new show on YouTube called “Music Therapy.” The interview series, which debuted on Wednesday with first guest Kam Patterson (“Saturday Night Live”), is part talk show, part improvised jam session. In each episode, Jay inhabits the role of a musical therapist, blending unscripted, intimate conversation with games and live songwriting. At the end, each guest will create a song or jingle with Jay.
